# Education Commission of the States

> ECS is the nation's only bipartisan, state-led organization dedicated to helping state leaders shape education policy through research, data tracking, and collaborative convenings.

ECS provides evidence-based policy resources, legislative tracking tools, and expert counsel to state education leaders. The organization focuses on key policy areas including early care and education, funding, data systems, workforce development, and emerging trends like AI in schools.

## Key Topics

- State education policy
- Policy tracking
- State leaders
- STEM/STEAM
- Workforce development
- Early care and education
- Education funding
- Data systems
- School choice
- Postsecondary affordability
- ESSA compliance
- Community engagement
- Education-to-workforce
- Policy priorities

## Policy Tracking & Resources

- [State Education Policy Tracking](https://www.ecs.org/state-education-policy-tracking): Track enacted and vetoed education bills across US legislative sessions
- [Resources by State](https://www.ecs.org/resources-by-state): Directory of state-specific education policy resources and profiles
- [Request Information](https://www.ecs.org/convene-counsel/request-information): Request expert counsel on state education policy issues
- [Governors' State of the State Addresses: Education-Related Proposals](https://www.ecs.org/governors-state-of-the-state-addresses-education-related-proposals): Tracker analyzing education trends in governors' State of State addresses

## Research & Policy Areas

- [Trending Topics in Education](https://www.ecs.org/research-reports/key-issues/trending-topics-in-education): Trending education topics including AI, cell phone policies
- [Six Policy Priority Areas Prepare State Leaders for Impact](https://www.ecs.org/six-policy-priority-areas-prepare-state-leaders-for-impact): Six priority policy areas framework for state education leaders
- [Data Systems Archives](https://www.ecs.org/issue/data-systems): Data systems, student privacy, and education-to-workforce framework
- [Early Care and Education Archives](https://www.ecs.org/issue/early-care-and-education): Early childhood education, pre-K, and child care policy resources
- [Funding Archives](https://www.ecs.org/issue/finance): Education funding, finance policy, and affordability resources

## Initiatives & Leadership

- [2025-27 Chair's Initiative: Community Hubs for Addressing Needs for Greater Education (CHANGE)](https://www.ecs.org/2025-27-chairs-initiative-community-hubs-for-addressing-needs-for-greater-education-change): CHANGE Initiative resources for community engagement in education
- [Who We Are](https://www.ecs.org/about-us): ECS organizational overview, mission, and governance structure
- [The Commission](https://www.ecs.org/who-we-are/the-commission): ECS Commission structure, commissioners, and governance committees

## News & Events

- [Ed Note Blog](https://www.ecs.org/blog): Ed Note blog featuring education policy news and trends
- [Events](https://www.ecs.org/ecs-events): Online and in-person events for education policy conversations
- [Newsletters](https://www.ecs.org/newsletters): Subscribe to Ed Note, Ed Clips, and ArtsEd Digest newsletters
